result.summary: The page is largely well-formed, but there are a few visual/content defects: a misspelled search placeholder, awkwardly clipped text on a horizontally scrolling card, and a partially cut-off category chip that may confuse users.

issues.description: The search bar placeholder reads 'Restarants, dishes, groceries' — 'Restaurants' is misspelled.
issues.suggestion: Correct the placeholder text to 'Restaurants, dishes, groceries'.

issues.description: The third card in 'Fastest near you' shows the restaurant name clipped as 'Trattoria Piccol' with no ellipsis, making the truncation look accidental rather than a scroll affordance.
issues.suggestion: Apply text-overflow ellipsis or constrain the label width to the card so partial words aren't hard-clipped at the screen edge.

issues.description: A category filter chip after 'Healthy' is cut off at the right screen edge with almost no visible content, giving little indication of what it is.
issues.suggestion: Adjust chip spacing/peek amount so a meaningful portion of the next chip is visible, signaling horizontal scrollability.

issues.description: The bottom pizza restaurant card is cut off by the tab bar with its title and details not visible above the fold, and the '-20%' badge floats without context.
issues.suggestion: Ensure card content scrolls fully into view and consider adding bottom padding so the last card isn't obscured by the navigation bar.
